title: Sage-Evolve-Preview:Adaptive Observation for Post-Training Self-Improvement
title_zh: Sage-Evolve-Preview：用于后训练自我改进的自适应观测
abstract_en: Post-training recursive self-improvement (RSI) iteratively improves a target capability, operationalized by a fixed anchor benchmark, through repeated intervention, training, and evaluation. Yet most loops use the anchor's aggregate score as their sole observation, so early gains give way to stalled progress and repetitive exploration. When this anchor-only feedback ceases to reveal actionable gaps, a plateau may reflect an exhausted observation rather than an exhausted capability. We introduce adaptive observation (AdaObs), an observation-side mechanism of harness evolution that keeps the anchor objective fixed while adapting the active observation. At a plateau, a controller refines diagnostic granularity, escalates difficulty, and adds related tasks; validated increments are fused back into training, while every checkpoint remains evaluated against the anchor. Across eight independently optimized anchors in long-context reading comprehension and instruction following, AdaObs raises the mean score from $66.4$ to $73.7$ under a matched data budget, outperforming FixedObs, the anchor-only baseline. The evolved harness further improves the seven-task average on the independent PostTrainBench across two agent backends. These results identify observation adaptation as a missing mechanism of harness evolution for sustaining post-training RSI.
abstract_zh: 后训练递归自我改进（RSI）通过反复干预、训练和评估，提升由固定锚点基准衡量的目标能力。但多数方法只用锚点基准的总分作为反馈，初期收益过后容易陷入停滞和重复探索。此时，瓶颈可能不在于能力已达上限，而在于总分无法再揭示可着手改进的短板。论文提出自适应观测（AdaObs），在保持锚点目标不变的同时调整观测方式。遇到平台期时，控制器细化诊断粒度、提高难度并引入相关任务，将经验证有效的改进纳入后续训练，同时继续用原锚点评估每个检查点。在长上下文阅读理解和指令遵循领域的 8 个独立优化锚点上，使用相同数据预算时，AdaObs 的平均分为 73.7，高于仅依赖锚点反馈的 FixedObs（66.4）。采用 AdaObs 的框架还在两种智能体后端上提高了独立基准 PostTrainBench 的七任务平均分。
key_points_zh: 锚点总分停滞不等于能力触顶，也可能是反馈过粗，无法指出下一步该改什么。
AdaObs 在平台期细化诊断、提高难度并引入相关任务，但所有检查点仍用原锚点评估。
在相同数据预算下，8 个锚点的平均分从 FixedObs 的 66.4 提升至 AdaObs 的 73.7。
在独立基准 PostTrainBench 上，两种智能体后端的七任务平均分均有提升。
